body.name: m0
body.def: Under the full-support design and overlap, \(m_0\) denotes the unique continuous representative, whenever one exists, of the conditional-mean equivalence class \(x\mapsto\mathbb E_P[Y\mid A=0,X=x]\); the law of \(X\mid A=0\) is equivalent to \(\lambda\), so every continuous, and hence every Hölder-continuous, version is unique. Every pointwise Hölder or box condition on \(m_0\) refers to this representative.
